class.name: NNBTTaskNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for Noodle Nodes behaviour tree task nodes.
class.description: Provides a [method on_tick] method for task nodes to implement to run their custom logic.

method.name: on_tick
method.description: Logic to be executed each tick. Must return one of [code]SKIP[/code] (-2), [code]FAILURE[/code] (-1), [code]RUNNING[/code] (0) or [code]SUCCESS[/code] (1). Task nodes that use the return value report any other type or value as an engine error naming the node and handle it as [code]FAILURE[/code].
